subject: Renewal & Q4 capacity review — competitive bake-off mention
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acornretail.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@acornretail.com>; Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal & Q4 capacity review — planning call

Hi Liam —

Acorn's annual contract is up for renewal on 2026-10-15 and I wanted to align on your expected capacity footprint for Q4. We saw a big uptick in holiday traffic last year and want to make sure we size your Dedicated pool appropriately if you plan to increase inference throughput or add new embed/semantic search workloads.

A couple quick asks so we can prepare ahead of our review call:
- Could you confirm anticipated peak concurrent requests and tokens/sec targets for Black Friday week?
- Are you planning any additional product launches or features (e.g., store-level semantic search) that would require extra throughput?
- I understand procurement will want updated pricing/term options and any SLA addenda, so looping them in here.

I have availability next week for a 30-min review. Proposed: Tue 2026-09-07 10:00-10:30 PT. Does that work?

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachment: inference_bench_req.xlsx (spreadsheet: suggested benchmarking scenarios and sample traffic profile)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acornretail.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@acornretail.com>; Priya Rao <p.rao@acornretail.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Q4 capacity review — planning call

Tessa —

Thanks for the heads up. A few things from our side:
- We're actively evaluating a competitor (EdgeFlow) who pitched a lower unit cost if we move to their managed endpoint.
- Procurement wants a bake-off / benchmark that mirrors our production traffic; I've attached the sheet with exact traffic slices and failure tolerances.
- Priya (CISO) flagged questions around KV-cache persistence and audit logs — she'll follow up separately with a short security checklist.

We still prefer Redwood's latency profile historically, but if EdgeFlow proves cost/perf improvement at scale we'll have to bring them into the final decision.

Tue 09/07 10:00 PT works for me. Procurement will bring our commercial lead on that call.

— Liam
Director of AI Platforms, Acorn Retail
liam.oconnor@acornretail.com

Attachment referenced: inference_bench_req.xlsx (updated with Acorn traffic slices)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-02T14:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal & Q4 capacity review — planning call

Team — forwarding Acorn's note. TL;DR: competitor in play, they want a production-like bake-off and Priya will send a security checklist. Prep asks:

1) Bench plan: we need a tight scope (3 workloads: product search, personalization rerank, checkout chat) and a baseline perf report showing 99p latency at target tokens/sec and cost per 1M tokens.
2) Offer: propose a staged renewal — 9-month committed Dedicated pool at current price + 6% discount if they expand capacity >1.5x. Include 30-day canary with rollback to hosted if issues.
3) Evidence: SOC2 + audit log export for last 6 months; Marcus can flag anything that needs ops support.

Marissa — please draft a mutual action plan and pricing options (MAP + 1 competitive concession). Vanessa — can your infra benching team run the scenarios in the attached sheet? Marcus — what does the telemetry export window look like? Monica — I'll need a short note for the leadership escalation path if the bake-off goes sideways.

We have the 09/07 10:00 PT kickoff. Can we have a bench plan and MAP ready by EOD 09/04?

Thanks —
Tessa

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal & Q4 capacity review — planning call

All —

We can run a targeted bench that matches Acorn's spreadsheet. Suggested approach:
- Duration: 48-hour continuous run + three spike days (simulate Black Friday burst).
- Topology: Dedicated GPU pool (4x A100-style vGPUs), plus a hosted fallback configuration for canary.
- Metrics: 99th/999th latency, p50 cost per 1M tokens, memory/KV cache hit rates, percent of requests served within SLA.
- Deliverable: PDF summary + CSV with raw traces + short replay harness they can run on their side.

I'll slot infra to start the run on 2026-09-05 if we sign off the plan by EOD 09/04. Draft attached: redwood-bench-plan.md

Two asks for Marcus: we'll need the audit-log export format and any throttling rules that could affect the replay. Marcus?

— Vanessa
Manager, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-bench-plan.md (markdown: bench steps, infra config, cost calc template)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-04T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal & Q4 capacity review — planning call

Tessa/Team —

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_Acorn_v1.docx) and our recommended commercial posture:
- 9-month committed Dedicated pool (baseline capacity per Acorn's sheet)
- 6% expansion credit if usage increases >1.5x within the commitment window
- 60-day price protection for any additional models onboarded during Q4
- One-time professional services hours (20) to support the bake-off and integration testing

If the bake-off shows quantifiable cost improvements from the competitor, we propose a 1-2% one-time match (escalatable to leadership approval) but keep contractual language that favors our rollback + canary clause.

I'll clean this up and send a client-facing MAP before the 09/07 call.

Attachment: MAP_Acorn_v1.docx

— Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acornretail.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procure@acornretail.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <p.rao@acornretail.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Q4 capacity review — planning call

Tessa / Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. MAP and bench plan look good at a glance. Procurement is happy to proceed with a bake-off; they asked to confirm two items before we kick off tomorrow:
1) Can Redwood provide the benchmark harness and raw traces so our infra team can validate replay fidelity?
2) Will Redwood commit to producing an auditable telemetry export (six months) and an operations runbook for the canary rollback?

If you can confirm both, we'll lock the kickoff for 2026-09-09 09:00 PT and have our procurement lead and CISO on the session. Also, please send a short executive one-pager summarizing the proposed concession and escalation path — procurement prefers something they can circulate to leadership quickly.

Looking forward —
— Liam
Director of AI Platforms, Acorn Retail
